display_long_description:
Step into a quiet garage where unfinished projects and family memories wait to be restored. In this hands-on VR experience, you assemble, repair, and clean a series of objects owned by your grandparents from small household builds to larger, more meaningful creations. Each completed task unlocks new tools, hidden parts, and personal memories told through photos and voicemails, slowly revealing a story about time, intention, and the things we mean to finish.

The gameplay focuses on tactile interaction: fitting parts together, removing rust, painting surfaces, and exploring the space for lost components. As the garage evolves, so does the narrative, blending restoration mechanics with emotional storytelling. Optional discoveries reward curiosity, encouraging you to look closely at your surroundings.

Designed to be calm and immersive, the experience emphasizes the satisfaction of rebuilding something with care. Every object carries a sense of history, and every repair brings you closer to completing a final project that ties the story together, a reminder that even unfinished work can hold lasting meaning.
